data.name: Singleton
data.description: At 5th level, a free hand fighter gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when wielding a melee weapon in one hand and leaving his other hand free. This ability replaces weapon training 1 and 4. This bonus increases by +1 per six levels after 5th.
